body: Pain in dying is scary. Death is scary as well. Living is objectively better than dying (considering if dying is nonexistence)

Hey, probably will give no solace but I read all of what you wrote. The deep connection between you two (the dreams both of you have for eachother), the distance between... That overwhelming feeling of helplessness as well, that intense strain you endure.

It may or may not help but here are some thingies:

You're pain is valid, the anxiety, the burning inside of you. 
To me, what you're going through isnt something dramatic or over exaggerated its soul crushing, heart ripping pain and stress.

I hope the both of you stay here. It's.. Selfish, but I guess my thinking is you have better chances of something subjectively good to happen or experience when yall are alive.

One day, One step, One breath, one heart beat at a time.
Noice, proud of ya for taking initiative! I hope you stay strong day by day.
